turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Rahul speaking. How may I help you? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, water is coming through my ceiling and I'm really worried about the damage. My policy number is OS-208635.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Oliver Bennett.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Bennett, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had a water leak at home and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It started about an hour ago. The pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water's gone across the whole floor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Everyone's safe, but the floor and the bottom of the cabinets are soaked and some electrics are close by.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And can you confirm the address of the property?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 14 Larch Avenue.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will you definitely cover all of this?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise the outcome as the claims team decides, but you've done the right thing by reporting it straight away.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Surely you can approve the repair costs right now though?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:05]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr Bennett, I appreciate your patience. Because it's an emergency you can arrange an urgent repair yourself, up to $500, without needing our approval first. Just keep every receipt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Bennett. I've logged your claim under reference CLM-28499, and the home claims team will contact you about the repairs.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Mr Bennett. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
